title: Add Taste and Tales themed images to About section

requirements.summary: Add four custom branded images to the 'What Makes Us Special' section in AboutPage.tsx, one for each value card representing Global Culinary Journey, Premium Quality Ingredients, Hygiene & Safety First, and Family-Friendly Ambiance
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four value cards displays a unique, branded image above or beside the text content
Images visually represent their respective value proposition while incorporating Taste and Tales brand elements
Images are rendered from frontend/public/assets/generated as static assets
Layout remains responsive and attractive on all screen sizes

file_operations.description: Add constants for the four value proposition images: global-culinary-journey.dim_400x300.png, premium-ingredients.dim_400x300.png, hygiene-safety.dim_400x300.png, and family-friendly.dim_400x300.png. Reference the exact generated filenames using the workspace path frontend/public/assets/generated/<filename>.

Import the four value proposition image constants from brandAssets. Modify the 'What Makes Us Special' grid section to include an element for each value card that displays the corresponding image (global-culinary-journey.dim_400x300.png for Global Culinary Journey, premium-ingredients.dim_400x300.png for Premium Quality Ingredients, hygiene-safety.dim_400x300.png for Hygiene & Safety First, family-friendly.dim_400x300.png for Family-Friendly Ambiance). Position images above or beside the card content while maintaining the existing responsive grid layout and preserving all text content unchanged.
